item.description:
What's new in 1.1.0

  • Screenshots and Recordings each have their own place in the window. Every entry shows a preview, when it was taken, which app was in front, and — for a recording — how long it ran and what was said. Open it, show it in Finder, delete it, or put a screenshot back on the clipboard.
  • Marking during a recording is visible at last: a red border says the marking layer is up, the box you drag is red, and it stays on screen for a moment saying "Marked". The border never ends up in the video.
  • The marking layer goes away on its own after ten seconds, and when the recording ends. That layer was invisible before — which is why the keyboard seemed dead until you hit Esc a few times.
  • Cueshot says it when another app listens to the same double-tap. Claude opens its Quick Entry on a double-tap of ⌥ unless you change it, and both used to fire at once.
  • "Got it" in What's new is readable in dark mode.
  • When a screenshot or a recording goes wrong, the log now says at which step.
